# tFPDF 1.34

Unmodified library and two bundled DejaVu fonts from [Setasign/tFPDF](https://github.com/Setasign/tFPDF/tree/69b06444b929e0d54ffbb5efcadfe97ecbad831b), pinned to commit `69b06444b929e0d54ffbb5efcadfe97ecbad831b`.

Only the PHP generator, font parser, regular/bold DejaVu Sans Condensed fonts and license metadata are included. The application loads the two PHP classes explicitly instead of using Composer. PHP `mbstring` is required. Documentation: https://www.fpdf.org/en/script/script92.php

Library license: LGPL 2.1, see `LICENSE-LGPL-2.1.txt`. Font license: `font/unifont/DejaVu_LICENSE.txt`. Generated font metrics may be cached alongside the fonts when writable; these contain no customer data.
